title: SX126X radio model validation
description: Cross-validate SX126X radio model across RAK4631, T-Echo, R1 Neo. Ensure consistent TX/RX behavior, power levels, and timing at all operating classes.
notes: Analysis: Blocked by infrastructure. RAK4631, T-Echo, R1 Neo all use nRF52840+SX1262. The nRF52840 HAL target is stubbed (commented out in lichen-embassy/src/lib.rs and Cargo.toml). Requires: (1) nRF52840 module implementation in lichen-embassy, (2) HAL test infrastructure (yqy6.9.15 is deferred). Software SX1262 behavior already validated via lora_medium sx1262 quirk preset and lora-phy abstractions (esp32s3.rs, stm32wl.rs). Cross-validation will be possible when nRF52840 support lands.
